notebooks.execution_method: Executed all 18 code cells sequentially from an empty in-process IPython namespace with scripts/execute_notebook_inprocess.py. The clean final run loaded exact current-master TwoFluidPipe, TPflash, and SurfCooldownAnalyzer classes ahead of the verified NeqSim artifact JAR, then executed OpenFOAM Foundation 14 build 14-7b05503f98a8 for fine, doubled-time-step, and coarse-mesh dead-leg cases. It retained every result-bearing output and nine PNG figures, produced zero error outputs and zero stderr, and generated both an updated coupling handoff and a reusable fine OpenFOAM case archive.
